source_row.rationale: Maintaining a clutter-free environment, with pathways clear of obstacles such as loose cords, equipment, or personal items, is a fundamental environmental safety practice that supports reduced trip and fall risk, allowing the client and staff to move safely and freely through the room — an important component of a comprehensive fall prevention approach.
source_row.source_detail: Clutter-Free Environment as a Fall Prevention Element
